lines.en: label dormwarssix4:
scene rocketshadowlegends
ARBY’S.
scene familywar1
: Okay, Chinami. Your big sister is still broken, so I’m going to take over as your legal guardian for now. Which, coincidentally, is also the same way I got adopted, I think.
: Chinami is confused. Does this make you her new mom?
: Not legally. But you can pretend I am until Chika’s brain stops being a slushy if that makes you happy.
: How can we know this is even her and not just a really well-made wax sculpture?
: My mind is here. I just can’t move my body.
: Don’t listen to her. Her mind is most certainly not here. What you are experiencing now is little more than fumes in the gas tank that is her existence. And she will soon fade away into nothing.
: This sounds problematic. Chinami always assumed that big sis Chika would be the one making funeral arrangements for her.
: Well, Chinami, there’s actually something we can do about that right now. Are you familiar with the Dorm Wars?
scene familywar2
: Yeah! Chinami got to participate in the first one and devised a ploy where she would drop dinner on purpose so that Papa would think it was cute and big sis Chika would win the date war.
: And she thinks it worked because big sis Chika was really happy the next time she came home! But that was also before all of the sex started and big sis Chika’s descent into madness began.
: Stop talking about sex. You aren’t old enough.
: That-
: She’s just on auto-pilot, I promise you. But also, she’s right. Don’t talk about that stuff anymore. Especially not in front of your friends.
if tsukasacurious == True:
scene familywar3
: Tell that to her! Tsukasa’s the one that planted this seed in Chinami! She just wanted to be a normal little girl!
: Realistically, this is all Jeeves’ fault. He’s the one who planted the seed in me.
scene familywar4
: Okay! Nobody’s planting seeds in anybody so long as I’m in charge.
: It was hard enough just convincing the camera crew to stay outside. The last thing I need is two wizards fighting for reproductive rights in the middle of a contest. Got it?
: Contest? You mean we get to participate in your genocide this time?
scene familywar5
: It’s not a genocide! We just need the two of you to choose who you’d rather have in your family out of the two other girls we dragged in here who haven’t spoken yet!
scene familywar6
: Damn. I was starting to hope she’d forgotten about us.
: Are you not good with kids, Otoha?
scene familywar7
: I just don’t have much experience with them. Even when I was younger, I didn’t spend much time playing with kids my age since I was too busy with music lessons and stuff.
: I guess being an only child doesn’t help either then, huh? I’m in the same boat there. No siblings for me.
: On a technical level, sure. But you’ve had Sensei by your side for years and he’s been the same age as us mentally for over a decade.
: Yeah, but I like him that way. It’s easier to get what I want and I know he won’t ever leave me because he’s not mentally mature enough to survive on his own.
: Did you mean to say that out loud or are we just suddenly friends and you don’t mind confiding in me?
: I think it’s more that I just stopped caring about the consequences of my actions because I know they will enrich my life regardless of their potential negative impact on the world around me.
: You’re weird. But I kind of like it.
: Thanks. I kind of like you too. Maybe we should be friends?
scene familywar8
: Ahem.
scene familywar9
: If you two are done flirting, I’d like to explain the rules of the contest now.
: We’re not flirting. It’d be weird for me to pursue Ami at the same time you’re pursuing her dad. The dynamic would be so weird if both couples got together.
: Otoha’s right. Just leave my dad to me and the two of you can start dating again.
: Don’t say anything that might get me killed inside of Chika’s house, thanks.
: There are so many places to hide a body here.
scene familywar10
: I agree. That was the first thing I thought after I moved in.
: Why?!
scene familywar11

: To protect myself, obviously! From both being murdered and the legal ramifications that would come from murdering someone on my own. Which I don’t intend to do, but I could. And that’s what matters.
: Okay! Cool! You’re both obviously very smart for your age, so figuring out what you’re supposed to do here should be no trouble at all.
: Just...form pairs or something and then play house or whatever. Or treat it like a job interview. I don’t know.

: Just come to some sort of an agreement on how Ami would be the better family member so we can get out of here and I can go suck at flirting with some mystery person who is probably just Kaori again.
scene familywar12
: Hey, don’t count me out just yet. I could still win somehow.
: I mean, sure. But do you even want to win? The prize is Sensei. Your victory does nothing but make my life even harder and you’ve done plenty of that already.
: What if I’m just trying to protect you from more heartbreak?
: Please don’t be. The last thing I need is the endless game of romantic tug-of-war inside of my head to become even more complicated.
: You’re all weird. Can’t I just keep my normal sister?
: No.
scene familywar13
: Well...yes, on a technical level. But in order to help us with our annual contest, you also need to choose between the lesser of two evils here.
: Oh, excellent. I didn’t realize you were both evil as well. Perhaps this won’t be horrible after all.
: Aren’t you Papa’s secret daughter? Doesn’t this already make us family?
: Papa? You call my dad “Papa?”
: He’s the only male figure in Chinami’s life. And she also believed that he would marry Chinami’s big sister one day, but those beliefs have been waning lately and that probably won’t happen.
: That’s right. Because he is going to marry me.
: Chinami thinks that is illegal and that you shouldn’t say things like that in public.
: How about you, Girl-Jeeves? Do you have any weird baggage to drop off as well?
: Girl-Jeeves?
: Jeeves is the name I give to all of my servants. And you intend to serve me as well, yes?
: Hey, new idea. Instead of that, why don’t I teach you how to play guitar? That sounds like a fun activity for brother and sister, right?
: Are you trying out for the role of my brother? I thought you were a girl.
: Oh. Uhh...right. Sister and sister, then. You cool with that?
: I guess so. Especially if Chinami and this other girl are already related.
scene familywar14
: Come with me, big sis Ami! Chinami is excited to add another sister to her ever-growing repertoire!
: Big sis Ami?...
: Huh...I kind of like that.
: Have fun while I’m off becoming the next Jimi Hendrix.
: Do you...intend to die by choking on your own vomit after taking a handful of sedatives?
scene familywar15
: Of course I do. I’m rich, aren’t I? That’s how we all go out.
: Chinami’s death will be much sadder. Which is actually a great segue to where Chinami will take you next!
: Uhh...what?
scene black
: And so they’re off! Is...Is what I probably would be saying if this part of the contest was televised. But it’s not, so...I’ll just go stand in the corner and wait for you to be done.
: Girl.
: Hah. But first, I will help transport you since you can’t do anything for yourself right now.
: Tsukasa, sit here and hold this. I’ve only got like an hour to make an impression on you, so I’m going to make it as cliche and endearing as possible.
: I understand. It’s important to play to your strengths during times of immense pressure. And I am a notoriously hard girl to impress.
: If you really want to earn my favor, though, another option would be teaching me about sexual education since everyone else I know seems reluctant to-
scene familywar16
: Yeah, so that’s not going to happen. Wandering into somebody else’s house and teaching somebody else’s sister about sex is not a thing I want on my portfolio. Do you have a good grip on the pick?
: I...think so? Which part is the pick?
: That little triangle in your hands. You’re not really supposed to use it with a classical guitar, but it’ll be way easier learning with this than your fingers.
: I see. So it’s like the uncivilized version of a bow for violin.
: You play violin?
scene familywar17
: Not well. I have played, though. My sister and I receive musical education as part of our at-home curriculum. It mainly involved instruments inaccessible to poor people, though.
: You know, I’ve got a friend who’s a phenomenal violinist. If you’re interested-
: I’m not. But please don’t let that dissuade you from carrying on with your intent to win my favor.
scene familywar18
: Deal. So, what you want to do with this hand is press your fingers down on the strings to form chords.
: Like on piano.
: Exactly. Just, instead of the keys, you have these little metal bars we call frets. And each fret-
: Changes the length of the vibration for a given string, providing a stopping point that ensures accurate frequency and intonation that would be harder to achieve via fretless instrument.
scene familywar19
: Oh, shit. Yeah. That’s...damn. You’re, like...legitimately really smart, huh?
: I absorb information well. It’s just technical skill that I lack. Also, you’re very pretty.
scene familywar20
: Technical skill is what practice is for. That’s not something a book can teach you and the only things that’ll ever really help are just repetition and routine. Also, what?
: Are you confused about your own teaching or that someone of my status called you pretty?
: The latter, obviously. Is that really something you should be saying to your sister while she’s trying to teach you?
: It was just an observation, really. My actual sister is pretty as well, but it’s a different type of pretty. Are you a model?
scene familywar21
: Focus, okay? Like I said, we don’t have much time to-
: Because you should be.
: Tsukasa-
if tsukasacurious == True:
: I’ve been watching pornography lately, and I think you’d find a great deal of success appearing in such works with looks like yours.
else:
: I hear that nude modeling is also an option for older people as well. I think that would be a good goal for you.
scene familywar22
: Huh?
: You’d likely make way more money doing that than you would playing guitar as well! You should really consider it.
: Sorry. Was that inappropriate for me to say?
: I wonder if the mood is this weird over on Ami’s side of the room?
scene familywar23
: Chinami would like you to meet the strongest woman who ever lived! This is her Mom, and she died when Chinami was still just a baby.
scene familywar24
: Chinami never got a chance to meet her because of that, but she’s heard plenty of stories from big sis Chika about how amazing she was.
: What can you tell me about your mom, big sis Ami?
scene familywar25
: Uhh...are you really sure this is what you want to talk about, Chinami? We’ve known each other for a total of five minutes.
: Chinami introduces everybody she meets to her mom right away! Just like she would if she was still here.
: But Chinami doesn’t get to meet very many people, so things like this don’t happen very often...
scene familywar26
: You did this same thing when you met my dad for the first time?
: Mhm! But Papa’s reaction was a little different from yours.
: How so?
: Mmm...it’s been a long time since then, so Chinami doesn’t remember it super well. But what she does remember is that it’s the only time she’s ever seen him look that way.
: She’s seen him a bunch of times since then! And even though she annoys him sometimes, he’s still the best dad Chinami’s ever had. Do you feel the same way, big sis Ami?
: My feelings are...a little more complicated than that.
: How so? Chinami might still just be a little girl, but she’s good at understanding stuff when it comes to family.
scene familywar27
: Yeah...it seems like it.
: Doesn’t it hurt, though?
: Hm? Does what hurt?
: Talking about your mom, I mean. Saying all those things about her and knowing you won’t ever get to see her face or...hear her voice or...smell her perfume again? That doesn’t sting?
: Nope! Not for Chinami.
scene familywar28
: But big sis Chika seems to feel that way sometimes...so Chinami is always extra careful talking about her mom around her.
: Maybe it’s just because she knew her better. Or maybe it’s something Chinami doesn’t understand yet...
scene familywar24
: But Chinami thinks it’s more important to celebrate somebody’s life than to get sad about all the things they can’t do anymore! So she tries to stay positive about that stuff.
scene familywar27
: You’re stronger than me then, Chinami. It’s been almost a decade since my mom died and I still can’t really talk about it.
: Well, do you want to talk about it? Because, like she said, Chinami’s a good listener! But if you think she’s too young to understand, big sis Chika also-
: Big sis Chika and I don’t really get along. She’s...not exactly a fan of how I look at “Papa.”
: Chinami understands that. Big sis Chika is super protective of him because she loves him so much. She even snapped at big sis Yumi and almost threw her over the balcony once because of it!
: He definitely has a way of getting us to do crazy stuff like that sometimes, huh?
: Big sis Chika does all kinds of crazy stuff these days. Chinami’s really worried about her. But if big sis Ami can be her friend, maybe it will make her feel a little better?
: I...don’t know about that, Chinami. I feel like some people are just...destined to be incompatible.
: Really? How come?
: All sorts of reasons.
: Like what?
scene black
scene unmei1
scene black
scene unmei2
scene black
scene familywar29
: Okay. So, now that approximately forty-five minutes have elapsed, we will begin the lightning round.
: Tsukasa and I will ask you a series of questions that you need to answer as quickly and honestly as possible.
: We will use your answers, combined with our own personal experiences with you today, to come to a conclusion on which of you we’d most like to indoctrinate into our family.
: She means “include.”
: No I don’t.
: Question 1 — If Chinami and Tsukasa wanted to have peanuts for dinner, what would you say?
scene familywar30
: No. You need much more than just peanuts for a balanced meal and the two of you are still growing.
: I’d say go for it. A little treat every now and then never killed anybody.
: Well congratulations, Otoha. You just killed Chinami and proved yourself wrong. I hope you’re happy.
scene familywar31
: Goodbye, cruel world! Chinami has perished. Blaaaah.
: Oh, is she allergic?! How was I supposed to know that?! She’s not even the one I was paired with!
: You’ve gotta think outside of the box for stuff like this, Otoha. These girls are smarter than they look and I imagine none of their questions are going to be direct.
: Question 2 — Otoha, are you the same girl who barked at Chinami at the mall that one time?
scene familywar32
: Bzzzt! Chinami knows you were and you can’t hide it from her! So weird!
: You bark at little girls in the mall, Otoha?
scene familywar33
: I told you I don’t have much experience communicating with kids! And she barked at me first! What else was I supposed to do?!
: Question 3 — at what age should girls start having sex?
scene familywar34
: Eighteen.
: Five-thousand.
: One more point for Ami.
scene familywar35
: Did you get these questions beforehand or something? I didn’t even know we were keeping score and you already somehow have three points.
: The trick is to just say whatever they want to hear.
: Well, yeah. That’s what I thought. And it’s why I agreed to the peanut thing. But now one of them is dead and I’m suddenly the underdog.
: You’ve always been the underdog here, Otoha. No one can fairly defeat me in a contest to see who the most family-focused girl is. Family’s all I care about.
scene familywar36
: On that note, let’s ask something a little more abstract and hypothetical. Chinami?

: If there was ever an alternate universe where Papa, AKA: Ami’s dad, turned into a little kid again and then subsequently fell in love with Chinami, would you cause problems at their wedding many years later?
: Probably, yeah.
: No. In fact, I likely wouldn’t even go.
scene familywar37
: Out of jealousy because you’d wish it would have been you that little Jeeves fell for instead?
: No! Because I don’t like weddings!
: Slight reddening of the cheeks. Elevated heart rate. Constantly looking away. Chinami’s internal polygraph is detecting a lie here.
: We’re going to need you to hand over your phone to check for illicit material. We hope you understand.
: There are literally no right answers. I’m being set up. How much did you pay them?
scene familywar38
: Phone not handed over. Suspicion not cleared. Confrontation dodged altogether. I have to say, it’s not looking good for you, Otoha.
scene familywar39
: Any chance you could try bombing this next question on purpose just so I can leave here with a shred of dignity?
: I know a good website for shotacon that I can show you once we leave.
scene familywar40
: Okay. It is clear that I am not meant to win this competition. I am graciously bowing out.
: You’re not alone. It’s everyone else who’s weird.
scene familywar41
: Oh. You guys are done already? I thought the lightning round was going to last a little while longer.
: It was supposed to. But then Otoha got scared that her deepest, darkest secret would be revealed.
: Really? Can I know? I think I’m owed some sort of embarrassing information after she managed to make it through our entire relationship without ever revealing a single weakness to me.
: I’ll tell you when you’re younger.
: Thanks. I-
scene familywar42
: Wait, what?
: Have you guys come to a decision yet? My friend’s contest is next and I want to try and make it over to the school before it starts.
: We have. Chinami — would you like to do the honors?
scene familywar43
: We, the esteemed elders of the Wizard Council and heads of the board of directors at Chinami-Corp, have elected big sis Ami as our new big sister!
scene familywar44
: No offense to you, Otoha. I actually liked spending time with you, even if it was only for thirty minutes. You’re way nicer to me than my actual sister is.
: It really came down to the fact that big sis Ami comes with added benefits for her dad as well. And you don’t really bring anything to the table in that regard.
: So I lost because I’m not related to Sensei. Got it. This definitely wasn’t rigged at all.
: You win some, you lose some. Just, in this case, you lost some. But hey, maybe there will be another contest you can win after this?
: The Dorm Wars only happens once a year.
: Oh. Then have fun wallowing in mediocrity until then, I suppose.
scene familywar45

: You’re heading over to the school to support Maya, Ami? Would you mind relaying the results of this match to Imani when you get there? I need to head over to the hotel to meet up with Uta before our thing.
: Sure, I’ll let her know. Are you guys all staying over there tonight or heading back to the dorms after?
: I promised I’d help Nodoka with something, so I’ll be there.
: I’ll be there too. Chika as well since I’ll likely need to drag her. Which leaves you two alone, it seems. Is this legal? Are we allowed to leave or does someone have to stay behind?
: I will stay. Bad things will happen if I do not.
scene black
: B...Bad things? What are you-
: She probably doesn’t want to be around for your date as it increases the likelihood of her actually murdering someone.
: Chika, it’s not a real date. It’s-
: Violence.
: Noooo. No violence. Be good. Watch her, Chinami.
: Okay! And goodbye, everyone!
: Have fun with your genocide!
: See you later, guys! Text me about that site, Otoha!
: Site? Like a...music thing? Or-
: Hahahah! Nope, it’s nothing. I will also leave now. Goodbye!
: Uhh...bye, you two!
: Please...take care of your sister.
